description: Save steps as a new dataset that Monity collects on a schedule (once a day unless changed in the app) and compares run to run. Try the steps with try_dataset_steps first and save only steps whose rows are right. Unless you say otherwise it is switched on and its first run starts now: the run collects every page and costs credits (1 for each page it opens, 5 more for each page an aiRead step reads, 2 for each started minute it uses a saved login); then get_dataset_runs says when it has finished and get_dataset_rows reads the rows. A dataset is a task: pause_monitor and resume_monitor switch it off and on, run_monitor collects it again, delete_monitor deletes it.

definition.description: The dataset's definition: { inputs, steps, rowKey?, limits? }. Read get_dataset_steps_guide first.

name.description: The dataset's name, as the person would call it: "Acme blog articles", "Competitor prices"

start.description: Switch it on and start its first run now (default true). False saves it paused.

name: create_dataset
title: Create a dataset
